label: Reel Caption Lane (timed kinetic phrases)
description: THE caption lane for vertical/square social cuts (9:16, 4:5): a timeline-driven stack of BIG kinetic phrases that fill their own box, one at a time, word-by-word. Unlike narration-track (a small lower-third pill over footage) this is the type FIELD itself -- give it the empty half of the frame under a camera card and it becomes the ad's headline track. Each phrase auto-fits its box, so a long line shrinks instead of overflowing. Burning the lane over live footage instead of a flat field? Set scrim:'plate' (or 'shadow') -- a moving ground is one the contrast gate cannot pre-empt, so the phrase carries its own. Wrap a word or run of words in *stars* to tint them with the brand's primary (re-mixed at runtime against the measured ground so the accent always clears 4.5:1).

phrases.label: Phrases
phrases.description: [{ text, start, end }] in scene-local seconds -- one entry per on-screen line. Drive start/end from the speaker transcript's word times so the type lands with the voice.

max_font.label: Starting font size in px before auto-fit (default 104)

min_font.label: Floor the auto-fit will not shrink past (default 44)

mode.label: Mode: stack (default: one phrase at a time, replacing) | tiered (the Scale Army cut: the running words small, the *starred* phrase big on a brush plate of the brand colour wiping in, the tail small beneath -- one small line when a phrase has no star) | scatter (each phrase lands at its own spot around the person and STAYS until the cut; over a cutaway the running phrase sits in the bottom band -- the lane must own the whole frame)

scrim.label: Scrim over live footage: none (default, for a flat brand field) | shadow (text-shadow only) | plate (translucent blurred card behind each phrase -- the burned-in caption look)

key_style.label: tiered only: plate (default: the starred phrase on a brush stroke of the brand colour) | plain (big plain white caps, no plate -- the payoff line). A phrase object may carry its own key_style.

small.label: tiered only: the lead and tail size as a fraction of the key's (default 0.44)
